subject: Terraform that builds the network, load balancer, container service and database for a billing service
conclusion: The root module builds a private network, then a load balancer and a container service, then a Postgres database that only the service can reach.
why: Each tier only accepts traffic from the tier in front of it. The database has no public route at all.

glossary.definition: a folder of Terraform resources that the root configuration calls with inputs
a firewall rule set that says which traffic may reach a resource

flow.title: How traffic reaches the database
flow.text: Data flows through three tiers; each tier depends on the network module's outputs.

items.label: Network
items.desc: The network module creates the private network, two public and two private subnets and a NAT gateway.

items.label: Load balancer
items.desc: The load balancer accepts HTTPS on port 443 in the public subnets.

items.label: Service
items.desc: The container service runs the billing image in the private subnets on port 8080.

items.label: Database
items.desc: The Postgres database runs in two zones and accepts port 5432 only from the service.

items.label: Outputs
items.desc: The root module prints the public URL and keeps the database address marked sensitive.

facts.text: Deletion protection is on for the database.
The production file runs four copies of the service.

inferred: A plan that changes the database engine version would replace the instance unless the provider supports an in-place upgrade.

lines.name: network
lines.text: Everything sits inside one private network.

lines.name: front
lines.text: The load balancer takes HTTPS and passes it to the service.

lines.name: back
lines.text: Only the service can reach the database, and the root prints the public URL.

lines.name: guards
lines.text: The database keeps seven days of backups and refuses deletion.

lines.name: reach
lines.text: Its firewall admits the service and nothing else.
